result: The bug was in `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts:16` — the `index` action called `.paginate({ page: page + 1, ... })`, adding 1 to an already 1-based page number from `ListPostsQuerySchema` (which defaults to `1`). That shifted every page forward by one: page 1 requested the ORM's page 2 (posts 11–20), leaving the 10 newest posts permanently unreachable and making the last page always come back empty. Fixed by passing `page` straight through. Added a `posts.index` test suite in `tests/PostController.test.ts` that seeds 25 posts and asserts page 1/2/3 return the correct 10/10/5 newest-first slices with correct `meta.currentPage`/`from`/`to`. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (5 pass, 0 fail).
